verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a local multimedia CLI and library suite, not a hosted service with accounts or an authenticated API. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows FFmpeg ships any credential-issuing capability, and the probes found no OpenAPI or hosted API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
